high_level_description: This image is a promotional post from Kylie Jenner's Instagram account, showcasing the "Glossy Lip Kit" by Kylie Cosmetics. The post includes a photograph of the product packaging and a model posing with a large wooden stick. Top Section: The top part of the image features a model lying on her side, propped up on one elbow. She is wearing a pink outfit and holding a large wooden stick across her body. The text "Glossy Lip Kit" is prominently displayed in bold pink letters at the top left corner. The model's face is partially visible
